state_unit.note: Constant input power approximation at the cited test conditions. Dalian Good Display Co., Ltd., 1.0, 2023-03-21; PDF pages 2, 7, 9. https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Other_Display/213-quadruple/GDEY0213F51.pdf

default_state.note: Assumes the display enters deep_sleep between full refreshes; controller commands are not simulated.

min_voltage_v.note: Cited operating supply range 2.3–3.6 V; upper limit is metadata only. Both supply pins share the logical rail. Dalian Good Display Co., Ltd., 1.0, 2023-03-21; PDF pages 2, 7, 9. https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Other_Display/213-quadruple/GDEY0213F51.pdf

states.deep_sleep.note: Directly listed deep-sleep power at 3.3 V. Dalian Good Display Co., Ltd., 1.0, 2023-03-21; PDF pages 2, 7, 9. https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Other_Display/213-quadruple/GDEY0213F51.pdf

operations.full_refresh.energy_j.note: 9.9 mW × 25 s at 3.3 V/25 °C; not a directly measured energy specification. Do not substitute GDEY0213F52 timing. Dalian Good Display Co., Ltd., 1.0, 2023-03-21; PDF pages 2, 7, 9. https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Other_Display/213-quadruple/GDEY0213F51.pdf Panel/reference circuit only; excludes host, radio and upstream losses.

operations.full_refresh.duration_s.note: Typical full refresh at 3.3 V, 25 °C. Dalian Good Display Co., Ltd., 1.0, 2023-03-21; PDF pages 2, 7, 9. https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Other_Display/213-quadruple/GDEY0213F51.pdf
